messages:
sarah: FYI — customer acme-corp reported a spike of 503s + timeouts on hosted inference since ~2026-03-15 03:10 UTC. Creating this triage channel. I can repro some 503s from EU host.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-629876. Oncall notified.
mike_r: I see a tight window of auth-proxy 502/504s at 03:09:22 -> downstream gateway started returning 503s from 03:10:05. Correlation: high retry traffic from frontend.
ben: Customer notes errors begin right after a nightly billing reconciliation job kicks off. Could be auth tokens/refresh storm hitting authz service.
vera: Traces show authz latency spiking to ~800ms with many 429 throttles. Retries from clients appear to exhaust conn pools causing gateway backpressure.
sarah: Impact: ~1.2% of hosted inference requests returned 5xx during spike; multiple customers reported timeouts. We should mitigate ASAP.
mike_r: Mitigation attempt 1: increased auth-proxy pool size and enabled 10s circuit-breaker on the /v1/inference route to fail fast and fallback. Command used:
```
kubectl -n hosted rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy
kubectl -n hosted apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: auth-proxy-config
data:
  conn_pool_size: "150"
  circuit_breaker_ms: "10000"
EOF
```
mike_r: After rollout, error rate dropped from 1.2% -> 0.3% within 6 minutes. Latency also improved.
ben: Temporary customer-facing note posted to support: "We're seeing transient auth throttles causing 5xxs; working on mitigation. If you see failures, please retry after 15s." :thumbsup: 
support: Customer acme-corp confirmed traffic recovered, but wants root cause and guarantee it won't repeat.
vera: Repro steps (dev):
1) Start a load test hitting /v1/inference with a small model (seq_len 512) at 500 qps from single client.
2) Simultaneously trigger billing job which refreshes tokens against authz (we have script in infra/tools/billing-refresh.sh).
3) Observe authz latency and gateway 5xxs in traces.
Curl repro (sanitized):
```
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -s -X POST https://hosted.api.redwood.ai/v1/inference -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOK' -d '{"input":"test"}' & done
```
vera: Logs excerpt (auth-proxy):
```
[03:09:21] WARN token_refresh failed status=429 retry_after=12ms
[03:09:23] ERROR conn_pool_exhausted waiting_requests=200
[03:10:06] WARN downstream_timeout route=/v1/inference
```
sarah: Short-term action items (owner):
- Increase auth-proxy conn_pool defaults and deploy circuit-breaker (mike_r) — done/verified
- Add short-term rate limit on nightly billing job to smooth token refresh bursts (ben) — in progress
- Add metric + alert for authz 95p latency and conn_pool_exhausted (vera) — in progress
- Customer comms + RCA timeline (support + sarah) — drafting
- Backfill quota handling in client SDKs to reduce retry storms (product) — follow-up
mike_r: Long-term: implement token cache at billing job side, reduce token refresh frequency, and add graceful degradation path in gateway to route to smaller model during auth pressure.
ben: Scheduling postmortem doc and action tracking. Proposed PT: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. I'll create the doc in docs/incidents/INC-629876.
support: Acme accepted interim mitigation, asked for ETA on permanent fix.
sarah: We'll close this war-room once monitoring stabilizes for 2h. Last check: 05:02 UTC error-rate back to baseline. Closing notes: follow-up postmortem + owners assigned above. Thanks everyone.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-629876 transitioned to RESOLVED by mike_r at 2026-03-15T05:10:00Z
mike_r: filing follow-up ticket: infra#4521 (auth-proxy conn pool tuning + tests)
vera: I'll attach trace samples and log dumps to the postmortem doc.
ben: assigning support action to @support for customer RCA delivery.
sarah: Closing thread. If any regressions pop up, reopen or ping oncall. :white_check_mark:
